instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging down and angled slightly wider than your shoulders.
2. Keep elbows pinned to your sides and upper arms still.
3. Curl both dumbbells up at the same time along their outward angle until they reach shoulder height.
4. Squeeze the biceps at the top.
5. Lower under control until arms are fully extended.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep upper arms still; only the forearms move.
2. Do not swing or use body momentum.
3. Maintain the slight outward arm angle through the whole rep.
4. Exhale curling up, inhale lowering.

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell with both hands using an underhand grip, palms facing forward.
2. Let arms hang straight down in front of your hips.
3. Keep upper arms and elbows still against your body.
4. Curl your wrists upward as far as possible toward your forearms.
5. Squeeze, then lower the dumbbell under control until wrists are fully extended.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Only the wrists move; keep elbows pinned to your sides.
2. Use a full range of motion, letting the wrists extend fully at the bottom.
3. No momentum; keep the tempo slow and controlled.
4. Use a weight that keeps form clean.

instructions:
1. Lie flat on your back with arms and legs spread wide in a starfish position, a dumbbell in each hand.
2. Lift your right arm and left leg toward each other, crunching and rotating your torso to bring the dumbbell across toward your left foot.
3. Lower back to the spread position under control.
4. Repeat on the other side, lifting your left arm and right leg.
5. Continue alternating sides.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Drive the movement from the core, not by swinging the limbs.
2. Rotate the torso so the obliques work, not just a straight crunch.
3. Keep the lower back from arching off the floor.
4. Exhale as you crunch, inhale as you lower.

instructions:
1. Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
2. Step your right foot forward and your left foot back into a split stance.
3. Lower straight down by bending both knees until your right thigh is parallel to the floor and your left knee nears the floor.
4. Push through your right heel to return to standing, keeping your feet in place.
5. Finish all reps, then switch legs.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your torso upright through the whole rep.
2. Track the front knee over the foot, not collapsing inward.
3. Drive up through the front heel.
4. Keep the descent controlled, not a drop.

instructions:
1. Stand facing a bench with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
2. Place your right foot fully on the bench.
3. Push through your right heel to drive your body up, bringing your left foot up to meet it.
4. Step down with your left foot first, then your right, back to the start.
5. Finish all reps, then switch legs.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Drive with the front leg; do not push off the trailing foot.
2. Keep the whole front foot flat on the bench.
3. Stand farther from the bench to bias glutes, closer to bias quads.
4. Control the descent rather than dropping down.
